title: ComposeShield Validation Report
description: Machine-readable summary of an on-demand or release CI pipeline run. Produced as validation-report.json and retained as a CI artifact for 30 days.

report_id.description: GitHub Actions run_id — globally unique within the repository.

commit_sha.description: Full 40-character Git SHA of the commit that was tested.

trigger_type.description: How this pipeline run was triggered.

generated_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when the report was generated.

overall_status.description: pass = all test_results are passed/not_automatable/manual_required. fail = at least one result is 'failed'. blocked = at least one result is 'blocked' and none are 'failed'.

pipeline_run_url.description: Deep link to the GitHub Actions workflow run page.

test_results.description: One entry per tracked test ID. Every test ID in the requirement matrix MUST appear here.

test_id.description: Stable identifier from the requirement-to-test matrix (e.g. C-001, A-002).

test_name.description: Human-readable description of the test scenario.

commit_sha.description: Full 40-character Git SHA of the commit on which this test was executed. Required per FR-012. Redundant with the report-level commit_sha for traceability when results are extracted from the report.

status.description: Outcome of this test. 'passed' requires actual execution on the stated device. 'blocked' = device/service unavailable. 'not_automatable' = scenario cannot be automated. 'manual_required' = physical iOS test pending hardware availability.

device_model.description: Device label from the cloud service catalogue. Null when environment is host-jvm.

os_version.description: OS version string, e.g. 'Android 14 (API 34)'. Null when environment is host-jvm.

evidence_url.description: Link to a screenshot or captured-frame artifact. MUST be non-null when status is 'passed' on a screenshot validation test.

timestamp.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when this individual test was executed.

failure_reason.description: Non-null when status is 'failed' or 'blocked'. MUST NOT contain sensitive content or marker values.
